name: plus
description: A solid rounded square with a centered plus cutout and two-unit clearance.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested Filled-only boxed treatment. The solid upright rounded square has bounds 2.15..21.85 on both axes and radius-2.85 corners. Its negative-space glyph is the unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke exterior of the Outline mark. There is exactly 2 units of clearance from the visible glyph to each of the four box sides at native 24px, X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Plus retains its own glyph dimensions and fitted upright box. X follows the same shared-glyph construction, with 2px outside its box and another 2px between the box and its unchanged Outline glyph, as documented in its metadata. The body is one evenodd compound path: the outer square followed by the original glyph as a cutout. This owner-requested exception deliberately adds a box only to Filled; the Outline glyph remains unboxed. The glyph cutout, rather than the new box exterior, matches Outline at Regular 1.70. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
